title: Elizabeth Carty
clean_html:
Elizabeth Carty

Preserved Primary Document • carty-e.htm

Photo Curtesy of John Carter Elizabeth Carty, the daughter of William and Elizabeth Carty, was born in Ridgely, Caroline Co., MD on 20 April, 1821. She never married but we know she had at least one child. It is said that the father of this child was Howard HARDCASTLE and indeed, the Hardcastle family lived nearby. Elizabeth's child Hopewell Umphrey Carter was born in the Cheswold DE community on 28 January, 1857. Elizabeth Carty died in Cheswold, DE on 26 April, 1906.
